## Update 2026-06-18:
* Host lookup updated to use complete_host_taxa_with_ecogroup_fixed.csv (mallard fix)
* Renamed taxa2 to taxa1p (1% of total N threshold)
* Added taxa1000: same cascade with minimum N = 1000
* Added taxa2000: same cascade with minimum N = 2000
* Added taxa2000h: taxa2000 with Homo sapiens forced as its own category regardless of N
* Added taxa5000: same cascade with minimum N = 5000
* Treemap legend font increased ~40% (8 to 11); export dimensions increased to 1300 × 1000

## Objectives
* Group hosts into multi-taxa consisting of species (where N sample >= 1% total rows), else genus (N>= 1%), else family (N>= 1%), else order (N>= 1%), else class
* Exclude environmental, insecta, food products
* export a table of the common hosts within each of my multi-taxa levels

# Setup

## Libs
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(RColorBrewer)
library(patchwork)
library(gtools)
```


## Ins and outs
```{r}
# Segment list
segments.ms<-c("PB2","PB1","PA","HA","NP","NA","M","NS") %>% mixedsort()

# Metadata (host, sample)
met.f.in<-"../../../phylo/01_fasttree/ft_rooted_outliers/2026-01-14_rem-outliers/rem_out/"
met.files<-list.files(met.f.in, pattern="resid.csv", full.names=TRUE)

# detect segment for each metadata file
met.seg<-sapply(basename(met.files), function(x) {
  m<-regmatches(x, regexpr("PB2|PB1|PA|HA|NP|NA|M|NS", x))
  ifelse(length(m) == 0, NA, m)
})

# re-order metadata files to match segments.ms; drop segments with no _fixed.csv
met.in<-setNames(met.files[match(segments.ms, met.seg)], segments.ms)
met.in<-met.in[!is.na(met.in)]

#host lookup data
host.look.in<-"../../../data/06_host/2026-01-27_out/complete_host_taxa_with_ecogroup_fixed.csv"

# Output directory
f.out<-paste0(Sys.Date(),"_out/")
if (!dir.exists(f.out)) dir.create(f.out, recursive=TRUE)
```

# Group hosts into multi-taxa by frequency
## Load in metadata and connect to host taxa
```{r}
# Load metadata for each segment
seggs<-lapply(met.in, function(f) {
  read.csv(f) %>% select(host, sample)})

# Bind metadata across segments and remove duplicates
all.seggs<-bind_rows(seggs) %>%
    distinct(sample, .keep_all = TRUE)
all.seggs$host.old<-all.seggs$host #same naming as in the lookup

# Host lookup
host.look<-read.csv(host.look.in)

#full match?
length(which(all.seggs$host.old %in% host.look$host.old))==nrow(all.seggs)

## Join all seggs to host.look ##
#Join taxonomic taxa
all.taxa<-left_join(all.seggs, host.look, by="host.old")

## ASSIGN taxa based on frequency of species detection
all.taxa$taxa<-all.taxa$species #default to species
all.taxa$taxa_level<-"species" #TRACK the taxa level
N<-nrow(all.taxa)
minN<-floor(N/100) #413 is 1%

#if a species is found in <1% of samples, then change to genus.
t<-table(all.taxa$taxa)
toofew<-names(t)[which(t<minN)]
index.few<-which(all.taxa$taxa %in% toofew)
#species==NA (only more generic avail)
index.na<-which(is.na(all.taxa$taxa))
#add to too few those with
index.few.na<-unique(c(index.few, index.na))
all.taxa$taxa[index.few.na]<-all.taxa$genus[index.few.na]
all.taxa$taxa_level[index.few.na]<-"genus"

# If still accounts for <1% of samples, merge into family
t2<-table(all.taxa$taxa)
toofew2<-names(t2)[which(t2<minN)]
index.few2<-which(all.taxa$taxa %in% toofew2)
index.na2<-which(is.na(all.taxa$taxa))
index.few.na2<-unique(c(index.few2, index.na2))
all.taxa$taxa[index.few.na2]<-all.taxa$family[index.few.na2]
all.taxa$taxa_level[index.few.na2]<-"family"
#check
# table(all.taxa$taxa)
# table(all.taxa$taxa[all.taxa$taxa_level=="genus"])
#  Anas  Anser Branta Corvus Cygnus  Larus Mareca

# If still accounts for <1% of samples, merge into order
t3<-table(all.taxa$taxa)
toofew3<-names(t3)[which(t3<minN)]
index.few3<-which(all.taxa$taxa %in% toofew3)
index.na3<-which(is.na(all.taxa$taxa))
index.few.na3<-unique(c(index.few3, index.na3))
all.taxa$taxa[index.few.na3]<-all.taxa$order[index.few.na3]
all.taxa$taxa_level[index.few.na3]<-"order"

#last chance: class
t4<-table(all.taxa$taxa)
toofew4<-names(t4)[which(t4<minN)] #moved this back to the minN used for other taxa levels in V3
index.few4<-which(all.taxa$taxa %in% toofew4)
index.na4<-which(is.na(all.taxa$taxa))
index.few.na4<-unique(c(index.few4, index.na4))
all.taxa$taxa[index.few.na4]<-all.taxa$class[index.few.na4]
all.taxa$taxa_level[index.few.na4]<-"class"

#CHECK
# table(all.taxa$taxa[all.taxa$taxa_level=="family"])
# # Accipitridae     Anatidae      Laridae
# table(all.taxa$taxa[all.taxa$taxa_level=="order"])
# t4<-sort(table(all.taxa$taxa), decreasing = T);t4
# sort(table(all.taxa$taxa_level), decreasing = T)

# append "Other" before the taxa if there is a higher level occurrence of it
taxa.vec2<-taxa.vec<-unique(all.taxa$taxa)
for (i in 1:length(taxa.vec)){
  #if species, skip.
  if(all.taxa$taxa_level[all.taxa$taxa==taxa.vec[i]][1]=="species"){next}
  less<-all.taxa %>% filter(taxa != taxa.vec[i]) #all but its members
  less.all<-unique(c(less$class, less$order, less$family, less$genus, less$species))
  less.all<-less.all[!is.na(less.all)]
  if(any(less.all ==taxa.vec[i])){taxa.vec2[i]<-paste0("Other ",taxa.vec[i])}
}
# anchor the patterns for exact match
taxa.vec.pat<- paste0("^", taxa.vec, "$")
repl <- setNames(taxa.vec2, taxa.vec.pat)
all.taxa$taxa<-str_replace_all(all.taxa$taxa,repl)

# table(all.taxa$taxa)
length(table(all.taxa$taxa)) #47 categories (going to remove environemtn and insecta and food products), so actually 44
#After v3 change ???
```

## Export the final data set of grouped multi-taxa hosts
```{r}
#reduce cols
all.taxa<-all.taxa %>% select("sample","taxa","taxa_level","common","host.old","class","family","order","genus","species","eco_group")

# export a summary table with the common hosts within the multi taxa
taxa.sum.table<-all.taxa %>%
  group_by(taxa_level, taxa) %>%
  summarize(n_rows = n(),# count rows in this taxa group
    common_hosts = str_c(unique(common), collapse = ", "), # distinct hosts
    .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(desc(n_rows))

taxa.sum.table<-taxa.sum.table%>%
  arrange(-n_rows)
tax.ord<-taxa.sum.table$taxa
taxa.sum.table$taxa<-factor(taxa.sum.table$taxa, levels=tax.ord)
taxa.sum.table$taxa_level<-factor(taxa.sum.table$taxa_level, levels=c("species","genus","family","order","class"))

#quick plot here:
taxa.sum.table %>%
  filter(!taxa %in% c("Insecta","Environment","Food products")) %>%
  ggplot()+
  geom_bar(aes(x=taxa, y=n_rows, fill=taxa_level),stat="identity")+
  labs(x="Taxa",y="N sample")+
  plot.theme
ggsave(paste0(f.out, "multi-taxa_freq_levels_counts.png"))
```

## Optional: convert the multi-taxa into common names
```{r}
taxa.sum.table$taxa1p<-as.character(taxa.sum.table$taxa)

#take single common host where species level
taxa.sum.table$taxa1p[which(taxa.sum.table$taxa_level=="species")]<-taxa.sum.table$common_hosts[which(taxa.sum.table$taxa_level=="species")]

## Do the same with the sample-level df (used in the partition script)
all.taxa$taxa1p<-as.character(all.taxa$taxa)

#take single common (not common_host, as above, but same same) where species level
all.taxa$taxa1p[which(all.taxa$taxa_level=="species")]<-all.taxa$common[which(all.taxa$taxa_level=="species")]
all(names(table(all.taxa$taxa1p)) %in% names(table(taxa.sum.table$taxa1p)))
#genus# taxa.sum.table$taxa1p<-str_replace_all(taxa.sum.table$taxa1p, c("Other Anser"="Other geese",
#                                          "Larus$"="Gulls",
#                                          "Corvus$"="Corvus",
#                                          "Other Cygnus"="Other swans",
#                                          "Other Anas"="Other ducks"))
```

## repeat treemaps for multitaxa
```{r}
library(treemap)

taxa2.cols <- setNames(brewer.pal(5, "Set2"), c("species","genus","family","order","class"))
excl <- c("Insecta","Environment","Food products")
```

```{r}
# taxa1p vs common host
tm.common <- all.taxa %>%
  filter(!taxa %in% excl) %>%
  group_by(taxa_level, taxa1p, common) %>%
  summarize(.groups="rowwise", tot=n())

tiff(paste0(f.out,"treemap_taxa1p_common.tiff"), width=1300, height=1000)
treemap(tm.common,
        index=c("taxa1p","common"),
        vSize="tot",
        vColor="taxa_level",
        type="categorical",
        palette=taxa2.cols,
        align.labels=list(c("left","top"), c("right","bottom")),
        border.col="white",
        bg.labels=255,
        fontsize.legend=11,
        fontsize.labels=12,
        overlap.labels=0.8)
dev.off()
```

```{r}
# taxa1p vs order
tm.order <- all.taxa %>%
  filter(!taxa %in% excl, !is.na(order)) %>%
  group_by(taxa1p, order) %>%
  summarize(.groups="rowwise", tot=n())

ord.cols <- colorRampPalette(brewer.pal(8, "Dark2"))(length(unique(tm.order$order)))

tiff(paste0(f.out,"treemap_taxa1p_order.tiff"), width=1300, height=1000)
treemap(tm.order,
        index=c("taxa1p","order"),
        vSize="tot",
        vColor="order",
        type="categorical",
        palette=ord.cols,
        align.labels=list(c("left","top"), c("right","bottom")),
        border.col="white",
        bg.labels=255,
        fontsize.legend=11,
        fontsize.labels=12,
        overlap.labels=0.8)
dev.off()
```

# taxa1000: broader grouping with minimum N = 1000
```{r}
minN1000 <- 1000

all.taxa$taxa1000 <- all.taxa$species
all.taxa$taxa1000_level <- "species"

t1000a <- table(all.taxa$taxa1000)
toofew1000a <- names(t1000a)[which(t1000a < minN1000)]
idx1000a <- unique(c(which(all.taxa$taxa1000 %in% toofew1000a), which(is.na(all.taxa$taxa1000))))
all.taxa$taxa1000[idx1000a] <- all.taxa$genus[idx1000a]
all.taxa$taxa1000_level[idx1000a] <- "genus"

t1000b <- table(all.taxa$taxa1000)
toofew1000b <- names(t1000b)[which(t1000b < minN1000)]
idx1000b <- unique(c(which(all.taxa$taxa1000 %in% toofew1000b), which(is.na(all.taxa$taxa1000))))
all.taxa$taxa1000[idx1000b] <- all.taxa$family[idx1000b]
all.taxa$taxa1000_level[idx1000b] <- "family"

t1000c <- table(all.taxa$taxa1000)
toofew1000c <- names(t1000c)[which(t1000c < minN1000)]
idx1000c <- unique(c(which(all.taxa$taxa1000 %in% toofew1000c), which(is.na(all.taxa$taxa1000))))
all.taxa$taxa1000[idx1000c] <- all.taxa$order[idx1000c]
all.taxa$taxa1000_level[idx1000c] <- "order"

t1000d <- table(all.taxa$taxa1000)
toofew1000d <- names(t1000d)[which(t1000d < minN1000)]
idx1000d <- unique(c(which(all.taxa$taxa1000 %in% toofew1000d), which(is.na(all.taxa$taxa1000))))
all.taxa$taxa1000[idx1000d] <- all.taxa$class[idx1000d]
all.taxa$taxa1000_level[idx1000d] <- "class"

# "Other X" prefix where a higher-level taxon name also appears as a lower-level label
taxa1000.vec2 <- taxa1000.vec <- unique(all.taxa$taxa1000)
for (i in 1:length(taxa1000.vec)){
  if(all.taxa$taxa1000_level[all.taxa$taxa1000 == taxa1000.vec[i]][1] == "species"){next}
  less1000 <- all.taxa %>% filter(taxa1000 != taxa1000.vec[i])
  less1000.all <- unique(c(less1000$class, less1000$order, less1000$family, less1000$genus, less1000$species))
  less1000.all <- less1000.all[!is.na(less1000.all)]
  if(any(less1000.all == taxa1000.vec[i])){taxa1000.vec2[i] <- paste0("Other ", taxa1000.vec[i])}
}
taxa1000.vec.pat <- paste0("^", taxa1000.vec, "$")
repl1000 <- setNames(taxa1000.vec2, taxa1000.vec.pat)
all.taxa$taxa1000 <- str_replace_all(all.taxa$taxa1000, repl1000)

# common name where species level
all.taxa$taxa1000_2 <- as.character(all.taxa$taxa1000)
all.taxa$taxa1000_2[which(all.taxa$taxa1000_level == "species")] <- all.taxa$common[which(all.taxa$taxa1000_level == "species")]

sort(table(all.taxa$taxa1000), decreasing=TRUE)
sort(table(all.taxa$taxa1000_level), decreasing=TRUE)
```

# taxa2000h: taxa2000 with Homo sapiens forced as its own category
```{r}
all.taxa$taxa2000h <- all.taxa$taxa2000
all.taxa$taxa2000h_level <- all.taxa$taxa2000_level

idx.human <- which(all.taxa$species == "Homo sapiens")
all.taxa$taxa2000h[idx.human] <- "Homo sapiens"
all.taxa$taxa2000h_level[idx.human] <- "species"

all.taxa$taxa2000h_2 <- as.character(all.taxa$taxa2000h)
all.taxa$taxa2000h_2[which(all.taxa$taxa2000h_level == "species")] <- all.taxa$common[which(all.taxa$taxa2000h_level == "species")]

sort(table(all.taxa$taxa2000h), decreasing=TRUE)
sort(table(all.taxa$taxa2000h_level), decreasing=TRUE)
```

## taxa2000h summary table and plot
```{r}
taxa2000h.sum <- all.taxa %>%
  group_by(taxa2000h_level, taxa2000h, taxa2000h_2) %>%
  summarize(n_rows=n(),
    common_hosts=str_c(unique(common), collapse=", "),
    .groups="drop") %>%
  arrange(desc(n_rows))

tax2000h.ord <- taxa2000h.sum$taxa2000h_2
taxa2000h.sum$taxa2000h_2 <- factor(taxa2000h.sum$taxa2000h_2, levels=tax2000h.ord)
taxa2000h.sum$taxa2000h_level <- factor(taxa2000h.sum$taxa2000h_level, levels=c("species","genus","family","order","class"))

taxa2000h.sum %>%
  filter(!taxa2000h %in% excl) %>%
  ggplot()+
  geom_bar(aes(x=taxa2000h_2, y=n_rows, fill=taxa2000h_level), stat="identity")+
  geom_text(aes(x=taxa2000h_2, label=n_rows, y=n_rows), vjust=-0.1, size=2)+
  labs(x="Taxa2000h", y="N sample")+
  plot.theme+
  scale_y_continuous(expand=expansion(mult=c(0.01, 0.13)))+
  theme(legend.position=c(0.9, 0.9), legend.justification=c(1, 1))
ggsave(paste0(f.out, "multi-taxa2000h_freq_levels_counts.png"), height=4, width=7)
```

# taxa5000: broader grouping with minimum N = 5000
```{r}
minN5000 <- 5000

all.taxa$taxa5000 <- all.taxa$species
all.taxa$taxa5000_level <- "species"

t5000a <- table(all.taxa$taxa5000)
toofew5000a <- names(t5000a)[which(t5000a < minN5000)]
idx5000a <- unique(c(which(all.taxa$taxa5000 %in% toofew5000a), which(is.na(all.taxa$taxa5000))))
all.taxa$taxa5000[idx5000a] <- all.taxa$genus[idx5000a]
all.taxa$taxa5000_level[idx5000a] <- "genus"

t5000b <- table(all.taxa$taxa5000)
toofew5000b <- names(t5000b)[which(t5000b < minN5000)]
idx5000b <- unique(c(which(all.taxa$taxa5000 %in% toofew5000b), which(is.na(all.taxa$taxa5000))))
all.taxa$taxa5000[idx5000b] <- all.taxa$family[idx5000b]
all.taxa$taxa5000_level[idx5000b] <- "family"

t5000c <- table(all.taxa$taxa5000)
toofew5000c <- names(t5000c)[which(t5000c < minN5000)]
idx5000c <- unique(c(which(all.taxa$taxa5000 %in% toofew5000c), which(is.na(all.taxa$taxa5000))))
all.taxa$taxa5000[idx5000c] <- all.taxa$order[idx5000c]
all.taxa$taxa5000_level[idx5000c] <- "order"

t5000d <- table(all.taxa$taxa5000)
toofew5000d <- names(t5000d)[which(t5000d < minN5000)]
idx5000d <- unique(c(which(all.taxa$taxa5000 %in% toofew5000d), which(is.na(all.taxa$taxa5000))))
all.taxa$taxa5000[idx5000d] <- all.taxa$class[idx5000d]
all.taxa$taxa5000_level[idx5000d] <- "class"

# "Other X" prefix where a higher-level taxon name also appears as a lower-level label
taxa5000.vec2 <- taxa5000.vec <- unique(all.taxa$taxa5000)
for (i in 1:length(taxa5000.vec)){
  if(all.taxa$taxa5000_level[all.taxa$taxa5000 == taxa5000.vec[i]][1] == "species"){next}
  less5000 <- all.taxa %>% filter(taxa5000 != taxa5000.vec[i])
  less5000.all <- unique(c(less5000$class, less5000$order, less5000$family, less5000$genus, less5000$species))
  less5000.all <- less5000.all[!is.na(less5000.all)]
  if(any(less5000.all == taxa5000.vec[i])){taxa5000.vec2[i] <- paste0("Other ", taxa5000.vec[i])}
}
taxa5000.vec.pat <- paste0("^", taxa5000.vec, "$")
repl5000 <- setNames(taxa5000.vec2, taxa5000.vec.pat)
all.taxa$taxa5000 <- str_replace_all(all.taxa$taxa5000, repl5000)

# common name where species level
all.taxa$taxa5000_2 <- as.character(all.taxa$taxa5000)
all.taxa$taxa5000_2[which(all.taxa$taxa5000_level == "species")] <- all.taxa$common[which(all.taxa$taxa5000_level == "species")]

sort(table(all.taxa$taxa5000), decreasing=TRUE)
sort(table(all.taxa$taxa5000_level), decreasing=TRUE)
```
